conjecture: Row-zero capacity: for an exact signed idempotent P, a row index i, and any vector y with P y = y, 0 <= y_j <= 1 for all j, y_i = 0, and y_f >= kappa for all f in a set F, one has kappa * sum over f in F of max(P_if, 0) <= nu_i, where nu_i is the row-i negative mass.
